title: Public project telemetry record
description: One registered project or explicit bulk bucket. Anonymous project_id values are stable salted codes; null timestamps mean that operating system has not been observed.

project_id.description: Public join key: approved label, anonymous code, ad-hoc, or remote.

project_code.description: Stable code even when an approved public label exists.

public_label.description: Approved public name; null preserves the default-anonymous policy.

category.description: Registry category or explicit bulk-bucket class.

registered.description: True when the registry or an explicit bulk rule resolved the project.

first_seen_at.description: Earliest provider metadata timestamp across both operating systems.

last_seen_at.description: Latest provider metadata timestamp across both operating systems.

sessions.description: Deduplicated provider sessions assigned to this project.

tokens.description: Vendor-correct token total; OpenAI reasoning output is not added twice.

api_equivalent_cost_usd.description: Exact-string API-equivalent cost, not subscription billing.

unpriced_tokens.description: Tokens whose observed model or class lacks an exact configured rate.
